name: MSI Mystic Light 185 (MAG B550 Tomahawk)
description: Direct zone mode for the 6 onboard LEDs of the MSI MAG B550 TOMAHAWK (MS-7C91) / MPG B550 GAMING EDGE WIFI via HID feature report 0x52 (185 bytes). JRGB/JRAINBOW headers are read and preserved but not driven until M2. Hardware notes: docs/hardware/msi-mystic-light-185.md (milestone M1).
